title: AgreementEventInstruction
description: Specifies the date of the event and the effective date of the event.

eventDate.description: Specifies the date of the agreement event.

effectiveDate.description: Specifies the effective date of the agreement event.

instruction.description: Specifies the instruction associated with the agreement event triggered by an amendment.

intent.description: Specifies the purposes for which the amendment agreement exists and how it will impact the agreement to which it applies.
